built-in
  smith.configuration · active · Outline of the Smith configuration and agent-profile reference: config.toml discovery and layered precedence, profiles with posture and inheritance, providers, credentials, model limits, reasoning controls, policy defaults, SMITH_ environment variables, and command-line flags. Activate before editing any .smith/config.toml or explaining how to configure Smith, then activate the section it names.
  smith.configuration.adaptive-cache-lifecycle-and-idle-compaction · active · Smith configuration reference, section "Adaptive cache lifecycle and idle compaction". Cache mechanism policy is profile-scoped.
  smith.configuration.command-line-selection · active · Smith configuration reference, section "Command-line selection". An omitted `--resume` ID opens a local picker only in an interactive terminal.
  smith.configuration.complete-example · active · Smith configuration reference, section "Complete example". Policy tables may be top-level or profile-scoped as shown.
  smith.configuration.conversation-compaction · active · Smith configuration reference, section "Conversation compaction". Persisted sessions enable semantic summarization automatically.
  smith.configuration.discovery-and-precedence · active · Smith configuration reference, section "Discovery and precedence". nearest `.smith/` directory.
  smith.configuration.image-generation · active · Smith configuration reference, section "Image generation". `https://api.openai.com/v1`.
  smith.configuration.model-discovery-and-daily-synchronization · active · Smith configuration reference, section "Model discovery and daily synchronization". authenticated `/models` listing.
  smith.configuration.policy-keys-and-defaults · active · Smith configuration reference, section "Policy keys and defaults". instructions may take together.
  smith.configuration.project-instructions-and-context-identity · active · Smith configuration reference, section "Project instructions and context identity". headless host examines exactly `<project>/AGENTS.md`.
  smith.configuration.prompt-cache-miss-notices · active · Smith configuration reference, section "Prompt-cache miss notices". `cache.miss_notices`.
  smith.configuration.providers-credentials-and-models · active · Smith configuration reference, section "Providers, credentials, and models". `[models]` declaration.
  smith.configuration.runtime-connections · active · Smith configuration reference, section "Runtime connections". actions.
  smith.configuration.smith-s-tools-on-installed-coding-agents · active · Smith configuration reference, section "Smith's tools on installed coding agents". By default an installed agent runs its own tools without asking.
  smith.configuration.vision-model-for-text-only-agents · active · Smith configuration reference, section "Vision model for text-only agents". A vision model answers questions about images for a text-only main model.
  smith.configuration.web-tools · active · Smith configuration reference, section "Web tools". Web tools let Smith read public pages and search for current information.
  smith.guide.extending · active · Extend Smith with skills, file commands, plugins, MCP servers, and modules; install, trust, list, and diagnose extensions.
  smith.guide.headless · active · Run Smith non-interactively with smith -p, pass prompts and images, choose text or JSON output, resume sessions, and integrate scripts and automation.
  smith.guide.models-and-thinking · active · Select or switch Smith models, enable or disable thinking and reasoning, choose effort and context windows, and verify model capabilities and limits.
  smith.guide.overview · active · Find the right Smith task guide; discover CLI subcommands, slash commands, setup, models, profiles, sessions, extensions, automation, and troubleshooting.
  smith.guide.profiles-and-advisor · active · Create and inherit Smith profiles, switch profiles and postures, configure an advisor, and control delegation and capability limits.
  smith.guide.sessions · active · List, resume, or start Smith sessions; undo, redo, or revert a turn's file changes; set multi-turn goals; inspect and follow up child agents; read status and history.
  smith.guide.setup · active · Set up Smith with a provider and model, connect credentials through user-run setup, configure image generation, and verify configuration and module availability.
  smith.guide.troubleshooting · active · Diagnose Smith startup, configuration precedence, provider and model errors, missing tools, inactive modules, trust, approvals, and session recovery.
  smith.guide.vision · active · Enable Smith image viewing for a text-only model, select a vision profile or provider/model, interpret image placeholders, and diagnose unavailable view_image.
  smith.headless · active · Outline of the Smith headless protocol reference for smith -p: input modes, text, json, and stream-json output formats, event framing, exit behavior, and resuming sessions non-interactively.
